topic: Data updates and model deployment plan
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on diagnosing issues with traffic and impressions. It was noted that impression data only accounted for 10 out of 61 sensors starting from October 3rd. The sender updated the data in `device_session_agg_ml_staging` for all frames, providing a list of IDs. Regarding model deployment, it was determined that the model needs to be updated on production with the latest changes and monitored the following morning.
decisions: The sender will process the aggregated data themselves.
